prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is approached, take it, move, check weight, and do task; if not, move to object, or else explore area. list of available nodes: <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />     <Action ID = GrabObject    />     <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> </Sequence> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />     <Action ID = TakeObject    />     <Action ID = MoveToLocation    />     <Action ID = CheckObjectWeight    />     <Action ID = DoSpecificTask    /> </Sequence> <Action ID = MoveToObject    /> <Action ID = ExploreArea    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO MoveToLocation
		DO CheckObjectWeight
		DO DoSpecificTask
	END
